description: This file is a JavaScript source file for the Materialize CSS framework, version 1.0.0-rc.1. It includes utility functions, component classes, initialization routines, and plugin mechanisms for UI components like collapsibles, modals, and others. It references external libraries such as cash-dom and jquery, and defines its own internal components and methods.
